h: Up the hill from Station Road
p: Station Road is the busy spine of Harrow town centre, so this Admiral sits among the bus stops, phone shops and takeaways rather than anywhere quiet. It's an 18+ adult gaming centre, which means it's one for the grown-ups only; if you're out with the kids, they'll need to stay outside with someone else.

Make a bit more of the trip while you're here. St Anns and St George's shopping centres are both a short walk away, and if you fancy a breather, head up to Harrow on the Hill. The old village has Harrow School's historic buildings and St Mary's Church at the top, with views right across London on a clear day. Harrow-on-the-Hill station puts you on the Metropolitan line into town.
